notes: Both records denote Liu Shi, Emperor Yuan of Western Han. Hanshu 27 identifies Emperor Yuan and his BC 48-33 reign, while Hanshu 38 supplies the dynasty-qualified title Han Yuandi and the personal name Liu Shi.

Hanshu 27's King of Hengshan in the BC 122 rebellion is Liu Ci, the former King of Lujiang named in Hanshu 44. This restores the source-backed personal name after the Hanshu 27 rereview replaced its local record.
